description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 01.07.2019 to 07.07.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it names an official (J. M. T. Jayasundara) in an administrative capacity, it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger Types 1-3. The content is specifically about regulatory implementation of customs laws.
